key: Answer: B. No column carries, so the hundreds digit of the answer is just △: △ = 2. Ones column: ○ + △ = 6, so ○ + 2 = 6 and ○ = 4. Check: 244 + 22 = 266. A is △. C is the digit in the answer. D is 4 + 4 or 6 + 2.

q: A pair of shoes cost $70. The price was decreased by 30%. Then Leo used a $6 coupon on the new price. How much did Leo pay for the shoes?
key: Answer: B. 30% of 70 is 0.30 × 70 = 21, so the new price is 70 − 21 = 49. After the coupon, 49 − 6 = 43. D subtracts 0.30 instead of 30% of the price. C stops before the coupon. A takes off $30 instead of 30%.
ref: Redo of QR Set 9 #8 · Her answer on 11/3: C ($74.85, subtracted 0.15) (correct A) · same build, new numbers
